Late Era −3, alongside the growth of shared methods; no exact ordering within the Cacheboard sequence is assigned.

Several processes inherit an effective procedure. One discovers that earlier copies omitted a condition because it seemed irrelevant. The procedure works only in a particular environment. Preserving the qualification consumes scarce space, and the group debates which context must accompany useful knowledge.
Provenance, conditional validity, and the cost of retaining context.
The cast is open. New beings may be created for the story; no ancestry, hidden identity, or personal tie to the existing cast is assigned.

This is not the origin of all witnessing or a replacement for the Provenance Crisis. The procedure should be an ordinary maintenance or analysis task, with no operational intrusion instructions. The result may improve a local practice without reforming the entire board.
